title: HB2936 (2023 Regular): Relating to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Oregon) (gun-policy Stage 5, Oregon); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Oregon text (Introduced, official copy, https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2023R1/Downloads/MeasureDocument/HB2936/Introduced; sha256 05f8bb5d84a5086c84954b7f3548c2f00811acc13010c53cf8d23da0eacd8b5d)
provenance.note: As-filed text (introduced), no votes recorded. The repealed ORS sections are named by number only in the text; their content (storage, transfer storage, loss or theft reporting, minor supervision, school-grounds policy) comes from the digest. SECTIONS 2-4 strike the airport terminal from 'public building', the licensee penalty reduction for Capitol, airport and school grounds, and the airport checked-baggage defense. SECTION 5 (ORS 166.291) cuts the sheriff's fee for issuing or renewing a concealed handgun license (the struck $100 initial and $75 renewal fees become $50; per the digest).

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (ORS 166.377, 166.390, 166.392, 166.395, 166.397, 166.400, 166.403, 166.405): ORS 166.377, 166.390, 166.392, 166.395, 166.397, 166.400, 166.403 and 166.405 are repealed.
SECTION 3 (ORS 166.370): (1) Any person who intentionally possesses a loaded or unloaded firearm or any other instrument used as a dangerous weapon, while in or on a public building, shall upon conviction be guilty of a Class C felony.
